description: End-to-end module generation template for ABP (Open Source) + Angular using Cursor.

Domain.template: Create an AggregateRoot entity <Entity> with private setters, constructor validation, and optional domain events.

Domain.Shared.template: Add enums, constants, permissions and shared DTO definitions.

Application.Contracts.template: Add DTOs and service interface. No business logic.

Application.template: Implement application service, inject repository, map DTOs with ObjectMapper, implement CRUD.

EntityFrameworkCore.template: Implement repository + entity configuration using EF Core conventions.

HttpApi.template: Add controller exposing API endpoints using AppService.

frontend.template: Generate Angular standalone components, use proxy services only, no hardcoded URLs.

workflow: 1. Generate Domain layer (entities, repository interface, domain events)
7. Run ABP CLI to generate Angular proxy
8. Generate Angular feature (service, pages, components, state)
9. Connect Angular UI to proxy endpoints
notes: Cursor must follow ABP naming & folder conventions strictly.
Cursor should not modify unrelated files during generation.
Backend DTOs generated in Contracts must match Angular proxy DTOs.
